name: volume_clock_signal_v1
author: claude_strategist
mechanism: On NIFTY, institutional TWAP/algo executions create bursts of high-volume 5-second bars where information content far exceeds low-volume drift bars. When the index RSI drops below 30 during a volume surge (vol > 1.5x rolling average), it means large sell programs have pushed price aggressively below the 5-minute Bollinger lower band AND below VWAP — a multi-confirmation exhaustion signal. The moment RSI turns up while volume remains elevated, market-makers and residual buy-side programs absorb the remaining sell flow, triggering a 10-20 NIFTY spot point bounce within 30-90 seconds. This approximates the volume-clock bar construction (treating high-volume 5s bars as 'information-dense' bars) without requiring dynamic bar regrouping.

indicators.name: rsi_12
indicators.purpose: 12 bars = 60 seconds — detects fast exhaustion at 5s resolution. Original used RSI(14) on volume-clock bars averaging ~1.5 min each (14 bars ≈ 21 min). We compress sharply to 60s because we hold 30-120s, not 3-10 min. The 1-minute RSI captures the same exhaustion concept but tuned to our hold window: if selling is exhausted within 60 seconds, the bounce starts immediately.

indicators.name: bb_upper_60
indicators.purpose: 60 bars = 5-minute Bollinger Band. Original used 20-bar BB on volume-clock bars averaging ~1.5 min each (20 bars ≈ 30 min). Compressed to 5 min because our hold is 30-120s — we need the band to reflect the current micro-session context, not the full morning session. 5-min window captures the recent tight range from which a deviation is meaningful at our timescale.

indicators.name: bb_lower_60
indicators.purpose: Lower band for oversold detection — same 5-min window as upper band.

indicators.name: vwap
indicators.formula: cumulative(close * volume) / cumulative(volume) from session open
indicators.purpose: Cumulative VWAP from 09:15 — no scaling needed. VWAP deviation confirms that price has deviated sufficiently from the fair value anchor that VWAP-benchmarked algos will start buying (bullish) or selling (bearish). Original used 15 bps deviation threshold; we adapt to the same concept.

indicators.name: vol_ratio_60
indicators.purpose: Current bar volume relative to 60-bar (5-min) rolling average. This is the volume-clock approximation: when vol_ratio > 1.5, the current 5s bar is 'information-dense' — equivalent to multiple volume-clock bars firing simultaneously. Threshold 1.5x chosen as the minimum surge that indicates genuine institutional order flow vs. normal noise on NIFTY.

conditions: vwap_dev < -0.0015 (>= 15 bps below VWAP, ~34 NIFTY pts at 23000)
buy_ce.confirmation: rsi_12 turning up: rsi[i] > rsi[i-1] (exhaustion confirmed, bounce starting)

buy_pe.confirmation: rsi_12 turning down: rsi[i] < rsi[i-1] (exhaustion confirmed, reversal starting)

exit.stop_rationale: 5 option points (≈10 NIFTY spot pts at delta 0.5). NIFTY volume-exhaustion bounces at 30-60s timeframe typically deliver 10-20 spot points. A retrace beyond 10 spot pts within 30s means the exhaustion read was wrong — institutional selling continues rather than reverting. Per CONVENTIONS stop/target calibration: 30s moves are 2-5 pts; we set stop at the upper end (5 pts) to give room for the bounce to develop.
exit.target_rationale: 8 option points (≈16 NIFTY spot pts at delta 0.5). Volume-surge exhaustion bounces on NIFTY typically cover 14-20 spot points in the first 60-90 seconds. 8 pts captures the median first-leg reversion without overstaying. At 1-min horizon, typical NIFTY moves are 3-7 pts (per calibration table); targeting 8 pts assumes the volume confirmation adds edge above typical moves (1:1.6 R:R).

filters.vix_filter: none (VIX not used; volume ratio implicitly captures volatility regime)
filters.time_filter: 09:20-15:20 IST (skip first 5 min pre-open noise and last 10 min)
filters.volume_filter: vol_ratio >= threshold (core signal, not a pre-filter)
filters.trend_filter: none — this is a mean-reversion strategy; no trend alignment required
filters.spread_filter: none — limit orders at candle close, no spread cost

edge.edge_decay_risk: Low-Medium — volume-clock concept is known in quant literature but rarely implemented at 5-second resolution on Indian index options. The multi-confirmation filter (RSI + BB + VWAP + volume) reduces signal frequency but improves directional accuracy.

adaptation_notes: Original strategy used RSI(14) and BB(20) on volume-clock bars constructed from NIFTY 50 constituent stocks (fires every ADV/300 shares traded). Key adaptations: (1) Applied directly to NIFTY index instead of individual stocks — the universe-level aggregation is replaced by index-level computation. (2) Lookbacks compressed from ~21-min (14 volume bars × ~1.5 min each) to 60s RSI and 5-min BB to match 30-120s hold time. (3) Volume-clock bar construction replaced with vol_ratio filter — this approximates the 'information-dense bar' concept without dynamic bar regrouping. (4) VWAP deviation threshold kept at 15 bps (original: 15 bps on stocks). (5) Stops and targets converted from percentage-based (25bps target, 12bps stop) to option premium points calibrated to NIFTY move sizes at 1-2 minute horizons.
weaknesses: Vol_ratio threshold may fire frequently in the opening 30 minutes when NIFTY volume is structurally elevated — could generate low-quality signals in noisy open.
RSI(12) at 5s bars can be noisy; the 'turning up/down' confirmation is only 1 bar, potentially catching transient bounces rather than genuine exhaustion.
Multi-condition filter (4 conditions + confirmation) may produce too few signals for robust statistical validation on 12 trading days.
